slides.eyebrow: If you only remember one thing about
slides.sub: Moving here? The dig site is a small park now. Two more stops sit near Kings Highway.

slides.title: Hadrosaurus Park
slides.meta: End of Maple Ave, off Grove St
slides.body: William Parker Foulke led the dig here in 1858. National Park Service records call it the world's first relatively complete dinosaur skeleton.

slides.title: Haddonfield Public Library
slides.body: The library itself dates to 1803. Adult cardholders can reserve free passes to area museums.

slides.title: Haddonfield Station
slides.body: PATCO trains run from here to Philadelphia and Lindenwold. The station sits right on Kings Highway.

slides.title: Haddonfield in an afternoon
slides.tip: Walk Kings Highway to Haddon Ave for the library. The park is off Grove St, a short drive away.
